question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to be upgraded in relation to upgradability?
data_point: ability of the product to be upgraded
description:
The ability of the product to be upgraded refers to the product's capacity to incorporate new functionalities or improvements over time, enhancing its performance, features, or compatibility with other systems. This aspect of upgradability is crucial for extending the product's useful life and ensuring it remains relevant and efficient as technology and user requirements evolve. Upgradability statements should focus on the aspects of the product that can help to lengthen the use and desirability of a product over its functional lifetime, including software updates to maintain product functionality and software upgrades to support new functionality on existing products for a specified period. <|ENDINPUT>|<|USER|>
